name: easycontact/easycontact
description: Development tooling for the EasyContact WordPress plugin. Nothing here ships at runtime.

scripts-descriptions.architecture: Fails on custom tables, direct DB access outside the allowlist, cron and assets outside their declared files, and the other invariants from CLAUDE.md.
scripts-descriptions.lint: WordPress Coding Standards and PHP compatibility.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: PHPStan with WordPress stubs, from tools/phpstan (installed on first use; skipped with a notice in cloud sessions, where CI runs it).
scripts-descriptions.test: PHPUnit against the WordPress test suite (needs WP_TESTS_DIR, see README.md).
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything above. Must pass before a task is done.
